idea: Amplitude sets how tall a sine wave is; frequency sets how often it repeats.

parameters.name: amplitude
parameters.why: Positive crest heights that stay inside the graph's y range of plus or minus 5.

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.why: From about one wave to nine waves across the graph; zero would make the period infinite.

parameters.name: phase
parameters.why: One full turn covers every possible shift.

moves: The wave travels right over time and the marker on the y axis rises and falls with it.
